response.ack_meaning: accepted into latest-frame queue; not a display completion
response.orientation_axes: +X right, +Y top (AI button), +Z out of screen
response.frame_orientation: send unrotated content; device rotates image, UI and touch automatically
response.rotation_convention: clockwise viewed from screen front; null when flat or unreliable
response.history_storage: RAM; photos retained, video sampled at 1 Hz; cleared on reboot
response.text_time: optional time HH:MM; otherwise SNTP UTC+8 or --:-- until synchronized
response.new_message_action: GET/POST /api/config: keep (default, unread hint) or switch; saved in NVS; settings and active gestures defer automatic switching
response.unified_sensor_ws: ws://IP:81/ws/sensors; full snapshots at 10Hz, type=sensors, schema_version=2, includes interact.slots.left/right
response.peripheral_control: POST /api/microphone or /api/camera {enabled:true|false}; 202 accepts request, poll applied_request_id/state/valid; default disabled, RAM only
response.peripheral_ws: buttons, microphone levels and camera metadata in existing /ws/sensors; media bytes via REST snapshots, not a continuous media stream
